description: Live web search for AI agents, powered by Tavily: send a natural-language query and get ranked results with titles, URLs, content snippets and relevance scores, built for research agents, fact-checking and RAG pipelines inside agent workflows. Search depth is fixed to basic server-side (one credit per call) so the per-call price always holds. No Tavily account, API key or subscription needed: pay per call in USDC via x402.
name: search-tavily
